nodes.label: Web Splash Screen Dark Mode
nodes.description: AshaSathi app splash screen dark-mode variant (available at 4x density). Displays the 'ASHA SATHI' wordmark in bold green text on a white/light background. A house icon with a green roof, white walls, and a green-framed window is integrated into the letter 'H' of 'ASHA', sitting above the 'SATHI' subtitle. The design uses a single green color (#4CAF50-range) for all elements with no dark background despite being labeled dark variant — the background remains white, suggesting the logo itself may be prepared for dark-mode host contexts.

nodes.label: Web Splash Screen Light Mode
nodes.description: AshaSathi app splash screen light-mode variant (available at 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x densities). Displays the 'ASHA SATHI' wordmark in bold green text on a white background. A house icon with a green roof and green-outlined window is integrated into the letter 'H' of 'ASHA', centered above the word 'SATHI'. The design is compact and clean with a single green tone for all elements. Higher density variants (2x, 3x, 4x) are pixel-doubled/tripled/quadrupled versions of the same design for high-DPI screens.

edges.note: Both splash variants share identical visual design (same green AshaSathi wordmark with house icon on white background). The dark/light distinction likely refers to the hosting app's theme context rather than a visually distinct background color in the image itself.
Light and dark splash images are paired theme variants for the AshaSathi web app splash screen, served based on the user's system color scheme preference.
